desc.en: The feast of the village’s patron saint, celebrated at the Sveti Martin church in Kampus.
Local families still produce wine in Žrnovo in the traditional way.
Walking through the hamlets – a walk from Prvo Selo through Brdo, Kampus and Postrana takes about an hour and passes churches, old houses and vineyard views at every turn.
